name: Global Health Academy website
publisher: Majid Sadigh MD Global Health Academy
brief: The list of the ten international partner countries and the domestic partners.
authority: The Academy's own public website is the primary record of its partnerships.
used_for: The eleven countries in this library.

name: WHO Global Health Estimates 2021
brief: WHO's estimates of deaths and disability-adjusted life years (DALYs) for every cause, country, age and sex. We used the 2021 country data for all ages and both sexes.
authority: The official WHO estimates that ministries of health and the UN use to compare countries. One method for all countries, so the ranks are comparable.
used_for: The ten ranked conditions for each country, with their DALY rate, share and death rank.

name: WHO country data pages
brief: The public WHO page for each country. It shows the same Global Health Estimates in charts.
authority: Published by WHO from the same data set as above.
used_for: The source link for each country in the country view.

name: WHO Global Health Observatory: hypertension
brief: The share of adults aged 30 to 79 with high blood pressure, and the share who have it under control, by country (2019).
authority: WHO estimates from the NCD Risk Factor Collaboration, based on national population surveys.
used_for: Hypertension as a local priority.

name: Maternal mortality estimates (WHO/UN MMEIG)
publisher: WHO, UNICEF, UNFPA, World Bank and UN Population Division
brief: Deaths of mothers per 100,000 live births, by country (2023).
authority: The joint UN estimates used to track Sustainable Development Goal 3.1.
used_for: Maternal conditions as a local priority.

name: WHO Global Tuberculosis Programme data
brief: WHO's yearly estimates of new TB cases by country, and the list of high TB burden countries.
authority: The source for the WHO Global Tuberculosis Report, built with national TB programs.
used_for: TB figures and TB as a local priority.

name: WHO Global Health Observatory: HIV
brief: Estimates of people living with HIV, new infections and treatment coverage by country.
authority: Joint WHO and UNAIDS estimates, built from national HIV program data.
used_for: HIV figures and HIV as a local priority.

name: WHO malaria case estimates
brief: Estimated malaria cases per country and year.
authority: The data behind the WHO World Malaria Report.
used_for: Malaria figures and malaria as a local priority.

name: WHO Disease Outbreak News: dengue, global situation (2023)
brief: WHO's report on the 2023 dengue season, with cases and deaths reported by each country.
authority: Official WHO outbreak report, based on numbers that countries report to WHO.
used_for: Dengue as a local priority in the Philippines, Thailand and Vietnam.

name: PAHO epidemiological alert: dengue (October 2024)
brief: Dengue cases, severe cases and deaths reported in the Americas in 2024.
authority: PAHO is the WHO regional office for the Americas. The numbers come from national surveillance.
used_for: Dengue as a local priority in the Dominican Republic.

name: CDC MMWR: dengue in Puerto Rico, 2024
publisher: US Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
brief: The CDC report on the 2024 dengue emergency in Puerto Rico.
authority: MMWR is the CDC's official weekly report, reviewed by CDC scientists.
used_for: Dengue as a local priority for Puerto Rico.

name: CDC National Center for Health Statistics: suicide
publisher: US Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
brief: The official count of suicide deaths in the United States.
authority: NCHS is the US federal statistics agency for death certificates.
used_for: Self-harm and suicide as a local priority for the United States.

name: IARC GLOBOCAN cancer fact sheets
publisher: International Agency for Research on Cancer (WHO)
brief: New cancer cases and cancer deaths by type, for each country.
authority: IARC is the WHO cancer agency. GLOBOCAN is the standard source for national cancer statistics.
used_for: Cervical cancer (Botswana, Zimbabwe) and prostate cancer (Jamaica).

name: Million Death Study: snakebite deaths in India
publisher: Suraweera et al., eLife 2020, reported by WHO
brief: A national study of causes of death in India. It estimates about 58,000 snakebite deaths each year.
authority: Peer-reviewed study, with WHO as a partner, based on a nationally representative death survey.
used_for: Snakebite as a local priority in India.

name: Uganda Sickle Surveillance Study
publisher: Ndeezi et al., Lancet Global Health 2016
brief: A national survey of 97,631 infants (tested through the HIV early infant diagnosis program) for sickle cell trait and disease in Uganda.
authority: Peer-reviewed national survey, done with the Uganda Ministry of Health.
used_for: Sickle cell disease as a local priority in Uganda.

name: Jamaica newborn sickle cell screening
publisher: Serjeant et al., Journal of Community Genetics 2017
brief: Results of newborn screening for sickle cell disease in Jamaica.
authority: Peer-reviewed study of a screening program run with the Jamaica Ministry of Health.
used_for: Sickle cell disease as a local priority in Jamaica.

name: WHO Western Pacific: hepatitis in Viet Nam
publisher: WHO Regional Office for the Western Pacific
brief: WHO's 2025 report on hepatitis B and C in Viet Nam and their link to liver cancer.
authority: Published by the WHO regional office with the Viet Nam Ministry of Health.
used_for: Chronic hepatitis as a local priority in Vietnam.

name: Crossref
brief: The registry where MedEdPORTAL records each publication's DOI, title and authors.
authority: Crossref holds the publisher's own record for each DOI. We used it to check every title in this library.
used_for: Checking that each MedEdPORTAL case is real and that its title is correct.

name: OpenAlex
brief: An open index of scholarly works. It gave us the title, authors and abstract of every MedEdPORTAL publication.
authority: A free, open catalog built from Crossref, PubMed and publisher data, widely used in research on publications.
used_for: Reading all 3,346 MedEdPORTAL abstracts to find the usable cases.

name: DOI resolver (doi.org)
brief: The service that sends a DOI to the publisher's page.
authority: The official resolver for all DOIs.
used_for: Checking that every MedEdPORTAL link opens the right publication.
